newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks dip amid market correction.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks dip amid market correction.

text.p: TALLINN, Jan 17 (Reueter) - Estonia's stock market was sluggish as most shares fell, pushing the index down 4.28 percent to 183.14.
"A price correction has taken place on the recently bullish market," analyst Katrin Kaarli from Hansapank told Reuters.

Overall official list volume came to 40.4 million kroons with the second largest Estonian bank Savings Bank registering 15.9 million kroons worth of activity. Its share price fell by 4.20 kroons to 80.60 kroons.
The usual market leader Hansapank turned over 13.6 million kroons and ended five kroons lower at 173 kroons.
Union bank saw its price fall by four kroons to 39 in volume of 4.2 million kroons.
The over-the-counter market was led by Rakvere Meat processing plant which registered 2.6 million kroons of activity and closed one kroon lower at 13 kroons.
The total volume of the free market was 8.7 million kroons.
